banner: SYNTHETIC OSSE RESULT -- generic synthetic worlds, not Korean-anchored. Statements apply to the declared nature and observation models only.

fuel_heterogeneity.spec: Per-archetype: patchy lognormal-like patches, or a non-burnable band
fuel_heterogeneity.why: Transparent synthetic heterogeneity; no fuel map is used.

ignition_bearing_deg.spec: Upwind bearing from the village +/- Uniform(-70, 70) deg
ignition_bearing_deg.why: Biases towards worlds where the village is downwind, without guaranteeing it: a substantial fraction of worlds never threaten the village, which is what makes unnecessary dispatch measurable.

ignition_distance_m.why: Chosen so the fire-to-village race is decidable within the horizon at the modelled spread rates. No observational basis.

resident_capability.spec: Bernoulli(0.45) self-evacuation capable, independent of route existence
resident_capability.why: Capability is an assumption about people, never an inference from the road graph (PROTOCOL.md section 6).

route_topology.spec: Perturbed 6x6 lattice, 72% of minor edges retained, connectivity restored deterministically
route_topology.why: A lattice is transparent and gives alternative routes. Rural Korean road networks are dendritic, not lattices -- recorded as a limitation.

spotting.spec: Enabled in 40% of worlds at the laboratory default rate
spotting.why: Spotting is one of the two mechanisms the experiment studies; its prevalence here is a design choice, not a measured frequency.

terrain.spec: Per-archetype: flat / planar slope / ridge / smooth noise
terrain.why: Synthetic. No DEM is used (PROTOCOL.md section 14).

village_geometry.spec: 6 houses within 900 m of the domain centre; base at one corner; two destinations at far corners
village_geometry.why: Terrain-independent placement. No village archetype data is used.

wind_direction_deg.spec: Uniform(0, 360) deg (direction the wind blows toward, CCW from east)
wind_direction_deg.why: No regime information is available, so the least-committal choice is used.

wind_shift.spec: 35% of worlds shift direction by Uniform(35, 85) deg at a time in the middle third of the horizon
wind_shift.why: Creates the forecast-relevant mechanism (a turn the planner cannot see coming) at a declared rate; the rate is not an estimate of how often real wind shifts.

wind_speed_ms.spec: Uniform(2.5, 6.0) m/s, constant or a single shift
wind_speed_ms.why: Upper bound is the laboratory's validated stencil limit (docs/VALIDATION.md#4), not a meteorological statement.

tuning.banner: SYNTHETIC OSSE RESULT -- generic synthetic worlds, not Korean-anchored. Statements apply to the declared nature and observation models only.

edge_optima: b1_m_per_ms_per_min=0.0 is at the edge of [0.0, 6.0, 12.0]
lead_min=90.0 is at the edge of [30.0, 60.0, 90.0]
visible_threat_buffer_m=150.0 is at the edge of [150.0, 400.0, 700.0, 1000.0, 1400.0]
lead_min=30.0 is at the edge of [30.0, 60.0, 90.0]

tuning.note: The forecast-aware policy is tuned once per forecast mode, at the undegraded condition, and is then held fixed across every error regime within that mode. Tuning it only against the weaker forecast would confound 'an accurate forecast is not worth acting on' with 'this policy was set up not to act on one'.
